name: 湘聚 Taste Of Home
reviews:
Absolutely love Taste of Home in Kingsford! Such a convenient location, especially being so close to UNSW.

The portions are incredibly generous and the food is seriously delicious. Every dish we ordered was packed with flavour — perfectly seasoned, beautifully presented, and full of that authentic “home-style” taste. The spicy dishes had just the right kick, and everything felt freshly made.

It’s the kind of place where you come hungry and leave completely satisfied. Great value for money, great atmosphere, and great food. Definitely one of our go-to spots in Kingsford. Highly recommend!

Thought it was a nicely presented, well-priced restaurant but you get what you pay for. Small, disappointing dishes with poor quality cuts and minimal actual meat. Lamb chops had less than 4 full-sized pieces which were actually fatty offcuts of ribs. The braised pork and quail eggs had scant meat in a watery sauce mixed with chunks of potato and pork skin/fat. Incredibly disappointing, will not return.

Delicious food and excellent service! If you're craving authentic Chinese cuisine that will hit the spot, definitely give this place a go!

Bonus: They offer free rice refills!

Taste of Home – Hunan heat you will happily suffer for.
486 Anzac Parade, Kingsford

We’ve walked past Taste of Home, and it is always busy.
Time to give it a go.

Tuesday, 6:30pm: Place packed
After a short 10 minute wait (just long enough to build anticipation and question our chilli tolerance), the ever-smiling staff  members found us a table for four.

The menu? A visual feast. Think high-res glossy menus with prices. No guesswork, just hunger.

We ordered with the confidence of seasoned spice adventurers. The results?

•	Barramundi with Garlic Sauce: Fragrant, fiery, and not for the faint-hearted. A chilli avalanche in the best way possible.
•	Crispy Eggplant: The crowd favourite. Crunchy, sweet, savoury perfection. PERFECTION.
•	Sizzling Lamb Chops: A bit fatty, meat tender and full of flavour.
•	Stir-fried Cauliflower: Yummy , loaded with garlic, chilli and a cheeky bit of grease.
•	Crispy Spiced Duck: Light on duck, heavy on crunchy chilli. More about the spice experience than the bird itself.

Tons of food. Tons of rice.
BYO-friendly, and you’ll leave with the unmistakable aroma of
“I just ate somewhere great for $30 per head.... AMAZING”

Post-dinner reality?
One of us hiccupped and burped for four hours after meal.
Another sought comfort in a bottle of Gaviscon and Enos.

Regrets? None.

Plans? Immediate return trip.

Taste of Home delivers on its name: warm, bold, a little chaotic, and just greasy enough to feel nostalgic. A spicy punch in the mouth — and we loved every second.
来了第一天就吃到了家乡的味道，谁懂这种感觉！特别好吃🥹🥹
